id.description: This is the unique identifier for the simulation suite.

orgId.description: This is the unique identifier for the organization this suite belongs to.

createdAt.description: This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the suite was created.

updatedAt.description: This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the suite was last updated.

name.description: This is the name of the simulation suite.

slackWebhookUrl.description: This is the Slack webhook URL for notifications.

path.description:
Optional folder path for organizing simulation suites.
Supports up to 3 levels (e.g., "dept/feature/variant").
Maps to GitOps resource folder structure.

simulationIds.description: This is the list of simulation IDs in this suite.
